records.text: The significant improvement in our results is primarily attributable to significantly higher average selling prices for our products, partially offset by significantly higher costs of corn and soybean meal, our primary feed ingredients.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The Company’s operating income for the three and nine months ended July 31, 2021 was $215.2 million and $356.3 million, respectively, as compared to an operating income and loss for the three and nine months ended July 31, 2020 of $39.9 million and $(53.8) million, respectively.
